scientific_integrity: Exact cap-multiplier proof, Darboux asymptotics, Weyl equidistribution and antipodal parity yield all infinite-degree statements. Included floating-point numerical checks are finite corroborations only.
scientific_limitations: Dimension at least two; generic theorem requires rational independence of two angles with pi; complementary case excludes hemispheres. Other resonant angle pairs and the circle are not classified. External literature comparison was bounded; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Generic rigidity and complementary-aperture resonance for spherical-cap covariance mixtures
